6489.title: Panel visibility changes detach existing controls
6489.rootCauseOneLine: The desktop header toggle and width-gated TOC rail detach their existing DOM nodes; both mutation sites reproduce in two clean trusted checkouts, but Chromium style invalidation and frame timing were not measured.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — targets both verified mutation sites; not executed
prReviews.topFinding: An open draft already closes issue 6489 and proposes mounted hidden controls; no competing fix was opened.

6489.proposedFix: Separate mount policy from control visibility, retain existing controls while hidden, and verify style recalculation and frame latency in a browser with relational CSS.
6489.caveats: Chrome/Chromium is unavailable to the required Browser Automation backend. The complete investigator-authored regression patch is inline in the report; no browser trace, screenshot, original latency numbers, or PR test run is claimed.
